messages:
maria: Heads-up — vendor (AccelRack) just updated the manifest. They pushed our reserved batch ETA from 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-22. Their marketplace still shows the original ETA. We have two Dedicated customers on Q3 commits. Can we triage impact + credit/reshuffle options?

raj: Ack. Linking vendor thread: https://vendor.example/threads/abc123 — I'm checking allocations now. Do we have reservation ids?

maria: Reservation ids: `RESV-94A2` and `RESV-94B7`. Vendor manifest excerpt below:
```
ACCEL-2026-06-22  | 40x A100-80GB | batch#B-77 | status: delayed
ACCEL-2026-06-01  | 20x A100-80GB | batch#B-76 | status: shipped
```
Their marketplace SKU still shows B-76 arrival 06-01.

tom: Ops note — if arrival is 06-22 we need to notify customers by EOD. What's our buffer for onboarding? ~2w for config + testing.

sophia: Sales: both customers already penciled for July beta runs — moving by 3w MAY be okay but we should prepare a formal credit offer. Propose 10% service credit for impacted billing period unless we can re-route inventory from another partner. :thinking_face: 

chris: CS: please don't promise credits until we confirm alternative capacity. Customer A is on Dedicated with SLA.

raj: I'm checking spare pool across partners, pinging Oriole (other vendor). @deploy-bot can you pull the marketplace reservation mapping for these IDs?

deploy-bot: marketplace-sync: fetched mapping for RESV-94A2 -> SKU A100-80GB / marketplace_id: MKP-778 / eta: 2026-06-01 (stale). Last sync: 1954318000. Recommended action: force-manifest-sync.

maria: Thanks. @raj please schedule a force sync and ask vendor for proof-of-pickup / updated BOL. Also need a comms draft for customers.

raj: Forcing sync now: `POST /internal/marketplace/sync?resv=RESV-94A2` -> 2026-03-21 12:14 UTC. Vendor asked for PO# to expedite — PO: PO-55122.

sophia: I'll draft customer note: short, apologetic, and offer temporary burst from spare pool + credit if we can't provide burst. cc @chris.

chris: Ack. Customer A (AcmeAnalytics) is sensitive to capacity changes. Suggest staged mitigation: 1) burst from spare pool; 2) canary on reduced capacity; 3) if not possible, 10% credit for July.

maria: Triage plan: raj to confirm spare-pool availability by 18:00 PT; sophia to send tentative comms; tom to prepare canary runbook. If spare available, allocate to Customer A and negotiate phased delivery for Customer B.

tom: I can run canary template. Adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-dedicated — will prep steps and rollback.

raj: Spare pool check: we have 12 A100-80GB available in APAC and 8 in NA. That covers Customer A (10 units) but not Customer B (25 units). Need reallocation + customer consent.

sophia: Proposing to offer Customer B a phased delivery + a discount for the partial month. I'll get verbal OK and follow up.

chris: Can we schedule a customer call today? 4:00 PM PT works for Acme.

maria: Booked 16:00 PT. Invite sent. Thanks all. :pray:

-- end of thread --
